description: This file implements an ActilityProvider class that serves as a LoRaWAN message provider for Actility within the Eclipse Hono project. It provides methods to extract device IDs, payloads, message types, and normalized data from incoming JSON messages related to LoRaWAN devices, specifically for Actility.

classes.name: ActilityProvider
classes.description: A LoRaWAN provider class for Actility that implements the LoraProvider interface, providing data extraction and normalization methods for Actility's LoRaWAN messages.

methods.name: getProviderName
methods.description: Returns the string identifier for this provider, 'actility'.

methods.name: pathPrefix
methods.description: Returns the URL path prefix '/actility' for this provider.

methods.name: extractDeviceId
methods.description: Extracts the device ID ('DevEUI') from the 'DevEUI_uplink' JSON object within the provided message.

methods.name: extractPayload
methods.description: Extracts the payload hex string from the 'payload_hex' field within the 'DevEUI_uplink' JSON object.

methods.name: extractMessageType
methods.description: Determines the message type based on the presence of the 'DevEUI_uplink' key; returns UPLINK or UNKNOWN.

methods.name: extractNormalizedData
methods.description: Normalizes various telemetry fields from the message into a map, including RSSI, TX Power, channel, spreading factor, SNR, function port, latitude, longitude, and gateway information.

methods.name: extractAdditionalData
methods.description: Removes certain fields from a copy of the message and returns null (possibly used to prepare data for further processing).
